id_and_class.summary: Mathematician John Starrett holds that every entity experiences, because an entity's experience is the time-varying pattern of its degrees of freedom as they couple with its environment. Rich human consciousness differs from an atom's only in how many layered degrees of freedom it has and in the internal ‘surrogate models’ that integrate them. Composite subjects form when entities engulf one another and reorganize their degrees of freedom, not by simple aggregation.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Experience as the Dynamics of Degrees of Freedom

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: An entity's experience is the structured evolution of its physical degrees of freedom (DOF) as they couple with the DOF of its environment; Starrett calls this pattern the direct model.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Identity: ‘our mentality is our structure,’ and that structure expresses our environment. Starrett invokes no nonphysical primitives.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (experience is present in every entity; complex forms arise as higher-level DOF are scaffolded on lower ones)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Surrogate models, internal stand-ins for features of the environment or the self, give organisms layered self-modeling on top of raw coupling.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Qualia are the felt aspect of an entity's direct model, shaped and layered by surrogate models that cushion raw interactions and integrate them into coherent patterns.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Entities modeled as fuzzy subsets of spacetime, their degrees of freedom (quantum states, phase spaces, neural state spaces), environments, and surrogate models.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Mathematical modeling of entities' degrees of freedom across scales, from Hilbert spaces for atoms to high-dimensional manifolds of sensory patterns.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Each entity has a ‘structural grammar’ that fixes what its DOF can express. DOF form a hierarchy: atomic states underlie molecular vibration, electrochemical gradients underlie neural signaling, and motor, auditory and conceptual subsystems combine in language.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal experience at every scale, from particles to human cognition; qualia; self-modeling; the combination problem.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Dynamical coupling between an entity's degrees of freedom and those of its environment, constrained by the entity's structural grammar.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Experience is an ongoing process, the evolving spectrum of an entity's DOF; each organizational layer inherits and reconfigures the dynamics beneath it.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Everywhere; boundaries between entities are graded rather than sharp, since entities stay entangled with their environments through persistent interaction.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Engulfing and co-engulfing let entities incorporate or mutually embed one another while keeping their direct models stable, so a composite's experience comes from reorganizing DOF into new patterns.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Surrogate models represent environment and self internally and integrate raw interactions into coherent patterns that manifest as qualia.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Complexity adds new kinds of DOF: chemical gradients and ciliary orientation in bacteria, then visual features, limb articulation and symbolic communication in multicellular organisms.
core_claims_and_evidence: Every entity, down to an atom with its electron cloud and spins, has degrees of freedom whose coupling with the environment constitutes experience.
Composite subjects arise through engulfing and co-engulfing, which Starrett offers as his answer to the combination problem.
The hard problem becomes a scientific and mathematical task: mapping how structural grammars at different scales produce the richness of human consciousness.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Mathematical and philosophical (dynamical systems, Hilbert spaces and phase spaces).

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The line between Radical Panpsychism and other panpsychisms is blurry, and defining the single unified reality the view assumes is philosophically and scientifically difficult.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Starrett concedes that mapping how structural grammars at each scale give rise to human-level experience remains to be done.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Starrett aims to unite physicalist science with panpsychist intuition, avoiding dualism's split and materialism's limits; identifying experience with physical dynamics keeps the view parsimonious but leaves open whether it explains feeling or redefines it.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Since every entity experiences through its coupled degrees of freedom, it follows from the view that an AI system has experience of some kind, shaped by its own structural grammar and surrogate models.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since mentality is an organism's structure, it follows from the view that a person's experience ends when that structure dissolves, though its constituents keep their own simpler experience.

virtual_immortality.rationale: The direct model is the physical coupling of an entity's own degrees of freedom, not an abstraction, so on this view a simulation would have its hardware's experience rather than the simulated person's.
